meta.project: LIEFS — LLM Inference Engine From Scratch

product_overview: LIEFS is a pedagogical LLM inference dashboard for exploring and comparing handcrafted generation optimizations such as KV-cache, continuous batching, paged attention, and INT8 quantization. It lets users run live inference, inspect benchmark results, and study memory/throughput tradeoffs for different decoding stages.
core_goals: Run live text generation with selectable inference stages
Compare benchmark performance across multiple LLM inference architectures
Explore how memory usage changes with context and batch settings
Review historical benchmark runs and export results for analysis
